summary: A North Pole man was arrested on a domestic violence assault charge, and three Nenana-filed cases carry felony charges: a first-degree burglary indictment, three third-degree assault counts and a felony DUI. The court's weekly report lists 43 new criminal cases at Fairbanks for Oct. 14–20.

entries.title: Domestic violence assault arrest: Christopher Reynolds
body: Christopher Reynolds, 50, of North Pole, was arrested on a charge recorded by troopers as fourth-degree domestic violence assault. North Pole, Oct. 20 at about 8:59 p.m.; Alaska State Troopers. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.

sources.label: Alaska State Troopers daily dispatch, Oct. 21

entries.title: Burglary indictment: Krista Marie Zappone
body: Krista Marie Zappone is charged by indictment with first-degree burglary of a dwelling, a Class B felony, plus two counts of first-degree criminal trespass (Class A misdemeanors), fourth-degree theft and two counts of violating release conditions (Class B misdemeanors). Denali National Park and Cantwell, Sep. 25; case filed at Nenana. Case 4NE-26-00096CR; competency hearing Nov. 13.

entries.title: Felony assault charges: Gregory S. Ashley
body: Gregory S. Ashley is charged with three counts of third-degree assault (repeat threat of death or injury), each a Class C felony, plus driving under the influence, fourth-degree assault and driving with a revoked license, each a Class A misdemeanor. Fairbanks, Oct. 9; case filed at Nenana. Case 4NE-26-00103CR; arraignment Oct. 28.

entries.title: Felony DUI: Lillybeth Elyce Hansen
body: Lillybeth Elyce Hansen is charged by indictment with felony driving under the influence (two or more prior convictions), a Class C felony, and driving with a revoked license, a Class A misdemeanor. Denali National Park, Sep. 24; case filed at Nenana. Case 4NE-26-00095CR; arraignment Oct. 21 at Fairbanks, bail hearing Oct. 22.

entries.title: Weekly court filings: 43 new criminal cases at Fairbanks
body: The Alaska Court System lists 43 criminal cases filed at Fairbanks and two at Delta Junction from Oct. 14 to Oct. 20, and none at Nenana or Healy. Courts were closed Oct. 19 for Alaska Day.

entries.title: Court calendar: 64 criminal cases at Fairbanks today
body: The Fairbanks court calendar for Oct. 21 lists 64 criminal cases: 56 filed at Fairbanks, four at Delta Junction, one at Nenana and three from courts outside the area.

entries.title: Building fire: 330 Third Avenue, Fairbanks
body: Fire crews were dispatched to a fire at 330 Third Avenue, Fairbanks, at 11:08 p.m. on Oct. 20; the call closed after about an hour. Crews also answered eight traffic collisions over the same 24 hours. Fairbanks Emergency Communications Center.

filings.note: The counts by court are the report's own for its own window and are a minimum. The report lists no filings for Monday, Oct. 19, the second consecutive report whose window covers that day. Four cases filed on Oct. 16 and Oct. 17 that were absent from the previous report appear in this one.
